meta.title: Filter the Articles List
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Filter the Articles List".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Filter the Articles List', 'joomlaguide-filter-articles', '

In this tour you filter the list of articles to find articles fast: on status, on category, and on several properties at once. Then you use a filter to publish a group of articles in one go.

The playground already has what the tutorial\'s Setup makes: the categories News and Events, each with four articles, published or unpublished, featured or not.

This tour follows the tutorial 5.1 Filter Articles List on Properties of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 5.1 Filter Articles List on Properties', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'All articles', '

This list shows all articles that are published or unpublished, here the eight articles of the tutorial and any you made before.

', 3, 'top', '#articleList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Filter Options', '

Click Filter Options.

A row of filters opens above the list.

', 4, 'bottom', '.view-articles .js-stools-btn-filter', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Filter on status', '

In - Select Status -, choose Unpublished.

The page reloads and the list shows only the four unpublished articles: Upcoming Announcement, Draft Press Release, Conference Preview and Meetup Planning Notes. Then click Next.

', 5, 'bottom', '.view-articles #filter_published', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"0"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Another status', '

Change the status filter to Published.

Now the list shows the four published articles instead. Then click Next.

', 6, 'bottom', '.view-articles #filter_published', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"1"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Reset the filter', '

In the status filter, choose - Select Status - again.

The list shows all articles again and the filters close. Click Filter Options to open them again, then click Next.

', 7, 'bottom', '.view-articles .js-stools', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Filter on category', '

Click in - Select Category -, type News and press Enter.

The list shows the four News articles: a mix of featured, not featured, published and unpublished. Then click Next.

', 8, 'top', '.view-articles .js-stools-field-filter:has(#filter_category_id)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Add a second category', '

Click in the category filter again, type Events and press Enter.

The filter now shows News and Events, and the list shows all eight articles. Then click Next.

', 9, 'top', '.view-articles .js-stools-field-filter:has(#filter_category_id)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Remove a category', '

Click the small × next to Events in the filter.

The list shows only the four News articles again. Then click Next.

', 10, 'top', '.view-articles .js-stools-field-filter:has(#filter_category_id)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Clear the filters', '

Click Clear, next to Filter Options.

All filters are removed and the list shows all articles.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-articles:not(:has(#filter_featured option[value="1"][selected])) .js-stools-btn-clear', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Combine filters', '

Filters combine: each one narrows the list further. You now look for the one article that is featured, published and in News.

Click Filter Options. In - Select Featured -, choose Featured Articles. Then click Next.

', 12, 'bottom', '.view-articles .js-stools', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Published', '

In - Select Status -, choose Published. Then click Next.

', 13, 'bottom', '.view-articles #filter_published', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"1"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'News', '

Click in - Select Category -, type News and press Enter.

One article is left: Product Launch, the only one that is featured, published and in News. Then click Next.

', 14, 'top', '.view-articles .js-stools-field-filter:has(#filter_category_id)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Clear the filters', '

Click Clear.

', 15, 'bottom', '.view-articles:has(#filter_featured option[value="1"][selected]):has(#filter_published option[value="1"][selected]) .js-stools-btn-clear', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Act on a filtered list', '

A filter also selects a group of articles to act on at once. You publish all featured articles that are still unpublished.

Click Filter Options. In - Select Featured -, choose Featured Articles. Then click Next.

', 16, 'bottom', '.view-articles .js-stools', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Unpublished', '

In - Select Status -, choose Unpublished.

Two articles are left: Upcoming Announcement and Conference Preview. Then click Next.

', 17, 'bottom', '.view-articles #filter_published', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"0"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Select all listed articles', '

Tick the checkbox in the header of the list.

Both articles are selected and the Actions button is enabled. Then click Next.

', 18, 'right', '.view-articles #articleList input[name="checkall-toggle"]', 2, 5, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Actions', '

Click Actions in the toolbar.

', 19, 'bottom', '.view-articles .button-status-group', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Publish', '

Click Publish.

Both articles are published at once.

', 20, 'right', '.view-articles #status-group-children-publish .button-publish', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Clear the filters', '

The two articles are published now, so they no longer match the filter and the list is empty.

Click Clear.

', 21, 'bottom', '.view-articles:has(#filter_featured option[value="1"][selected]):has(#filter_published option[value="0"][selected]) .js-stools-btn-clear', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-filter-articles'), 'Well done!', '

The list shows all articles again, now with Upcoming Announcement and Conference Preview published.

The same filters are in other lists of Joomla too, such as Categories and the menu items.

', 22, 'top', '#articleList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
